consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(Q_axle) = Q_static + ΔQ_dynamic; F = [1 1], f = [0] (sum of static and dynamic increment)
consistency_relations.upr_description: Dynamic axle load is the affine sum of the static axle load and a dynamic increment caused by track geometry and speed: Q_dyn = Q_static + ΔQ. This parametric mapping aggregates two independent uncertainty contributions into total dynamic load, which must remain below the D4 infrastructure limit of 165 kN.
